patterns.name: Basso
patterns.description: Main bass reharmonized to E minor tango: Em-Am-B7-Em with C/F#dim/B7 turnarounds.

patterns.name: Jouset
patterns.description: Main strings: E minor tango progression with clear B7 authentic cadences.

patterns.name: Komppi
patterns.description: Komppi stabs follow the cleaned E minor tango harmony.

patterns.name: Basso (copy)
patterns.description: Second bass section uses darker C-F#dim-B7 pullbacks into Em.

patterns.name: Jouset (copy)
patterns.description: Reprise strings: darker C-F#dim7-B7 motion prevents the D section from sagging.

patterns.name: Komppi (copy)
patterns.description: Komppi reprise uses darker dominant preparation.

patterns.name: Intro Basso Pickup
patterns.description: Intro bass now establishes E minor: i-iv-V7-i, then bVI-ii dim7-V7-i.

patterns.name: Intro Jouset Haze
patterns.description: Intro strings: early E minor grounding, stark iv and F#dim7/B7 cadence.

patterns.name: Stick Basso
patterns.description: Stick bass gives a concise E minor pre-dominant to dominant cadence.

patterns.name: Stick Jouset
patterns.description: Stick strings: compact minor cadence chain.

patterns.name: Outro Basso
patterns.description: Outro bass resolves C-F#dim-B7 into a bare Em close.

patterns.name: Final B Bass Lift
patterns.description: Final lift bass keeps tango lift but routes it back through F#dim-B7-Em.

patterns.name: Final B Jouset Lift
patterns.description: Final strings: lift through D/G but cadence home via F#dim7-B7-Em.

patterns.name: Final B Haitari Lift
patterns.description: Final accordion lift reharmonized to a late F#dim7-B7-Em arrival.
